role: Requested exact definition-only supplement; only these excerpts are newly whitelisted, not entire source modules. No proofs/fixtures/auditor/receipt supplied.

definitions.excerpt:
def subtree : Tree → Vertex → Option Tree
  | t, [] => some t
  | .leaf _, _ :: _ => none
  | .node l r, b :: v => subtree (if b then r else l) v

def Valid (t : Tree) (v : Vertex) : Prop := ∃ s, subtree t v = some s

def LeafAt (t : Tree) (v : Vertex) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  subtree t v = some (.leaf x)

def CherryAt (t : Tree) (p : Vertex) (x y : Nat) : Prop :=
  subtree t p = some (.node (.leaf x) (.leaf y))

def Refines (F Q : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ P, P ∈ F → ∃ R, R ∈ Q ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ P → x ∈ R

def yes (C : List Nat) (q : Nat → Bool) := C.filter q
def no (C : List Nat) (q : Nat → Bool) := C.filter (fun x => !q x)

def split (C : List Nat) (q : Nat → Bool) : List (List Nat) :=
  [yes C q,no C q].filter (fun b => !b.isEmpty)
def splitAll (V : List (List Nat)) (q : Nat → Bool) := V.flatMap (fun C => split C q)

ordering: yes split part is emitted before no part, and original block order is preserved by flatMap; filter removes empty parts. This is literal splitAll definition semantics, not a validity/cost proof.
